entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Coach Todd Monken said Monday the team is still evaluating the severity of Sampson's knee injury, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (personal) remains on the Commissioner's Exempt List, but the NFL may count time on the list as time served if it eventually issues a suspension to the running back, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tip Reiman
entries.summary: The Cardinals moved Reiman (ankle) from the active/PUP list to the reserve/PUP list Sunday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: out

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) is expected to miss at least one month after he was diagnosed Sunday with a deltoid sprain of his left ankle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Lane will receive second and third medical opinions on his injured wrist this week before a timeline for his return is established, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
entries.summary: Lambert-Smith (hamstring) will miss some time after exiting last Sunday's game against the Cardinals early, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Darnold (glute) is "looking at about a four-week return to play" but could return "a little bit sooner than that," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that Pierce is "good right now" after banging up his wrist in Sunday's 41-23 loss to the Ravens, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Alvin Kamara
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
entries.summary: Coach Liam Coen said Monday that Thomas (shoulder) will be limited in practice this week, Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak labeled Bowers (knee) as day-to-day Monday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Okonkwo is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 1 game against Philadelphia due to a hamstring injury.

entries.name: Derius Davis
entries.summary: Davis (undisclosed) is day-to-day with an injury he suffered during Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.

entries.name: Devontez Walker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jake Tonges
entries.summary: Coach Kyle Shanahan said after Thursday night's win over the Rams that Tonges' knee injury "does not look good," Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker is in a walking boot Monday after sustaining a left ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Bears, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Mason is being further evaluated after experiencing thumb soreness coming out of Sunday's 39-22 win over the Packers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Whyle
entries.summary: Whyle (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Vikings.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray is in concussion protocol and will be evaluated day by day leading up Sunday's road game in Chicago, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh labeled McConkey (rib) as day-to-day Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Harbaugh added that the Chargers will see how McConkey progresses throughout the week before determining his availability for Sunday's game agains the Raiders.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Cooper (ankle) is "week-to-week," and the hope is he returns "within the next four weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Oscar Delp
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Sean Tucker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tory Horton
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel said Henderson (ankle) will practice Monday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tua Tagovailoa
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ty Johnson
entries.summary: The Bills listed Johnson (hamstring) as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Flowers (hamstring) is considered day-to-day, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown, who was officially placed on injured reserve Saturday, is expected to miss about six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens on Sunday with a designation to return, Ryan Mink of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Audric Estime
entries.summary: The Saints placed Estime (thigh) on injured reserve Saturday, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Ben Yurosek
entries.summary: Minnesota placed Yurosek on injured reserve Tuesday due to an undisclosed injury.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders on Sunday with a designation to return.

entries.name: D.J. Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (abdomen) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: David Sills
entries.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Pacheco (back) underwent surgery Monday and is expected to be out for a significant amount of time, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: The Cardinals are placing Conner (foot) on injured reserve with a designation to return, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM Phoenix reports.

entries.name: Jayden Higgins
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Malik Davis
entries.summary: The Cowboys placed Davis (hip) on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Dell (knee) agreed to take a pay cut from the Texans on Friday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Tim Patrick
entries.summary: The Jets placed Patrick (groin) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Trey Sermon
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) was placed on injured reserve by the Colts on Sunday with a designation to return, JJ Stankevitz of the team's official website reports.
